model.purpose: Tags parts of speech and lemmas in {language} texts.
model.about.sm: Fast and light; a good choice to start with and for large corpora.
model.about.md: A bit more accurate than the small one; includes word vectors (useful for similarity).
model.about.lg: More word vectors than the medium one; part-of-speech accuracy is similar, but the download is large.
model.about.trf: spaCy's most accurate model, transformer-based (RoBERTa); much slower, and it needs a component this app does not ship yet.
model.about.stanza: Neural model from Stanza (Stanford University), used by the Stanza tagger; slower than spaCy and usually more accurate for lemmas and parts of speech.
model.reason.requires: Needs the Python package '{module}', which is not available in this installation.
